title: group_by: aggregate rows by a categorical column
description: Group rows by a categorical column and compute an aggregate (sum, mean, count, min, max) on a numeric target column. Produces one row per group. Use this when the user asks to summarise, total, average, or count values across categories, regions, or time periods.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: The primary column to group by. For single-column grouping, use this field. Example: 'region'.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Optional list of columns for multi-column grouping. When provided, takes precedence over the single 'column' field. Example: ['region', 'category'].

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The numeric column to aggregate. Must exist in the dataset and contain numeric values. Example: 'sales', 'revenue', 'quantity'.

parameters.name: agg
parameters.description: Aggregation function. Allowed values: sum (total), mean (average), count (number of rows), min (minimum), max (maximum).

rag_note: Only use columns that exist in the dataset. The validator will reject references to missing columns. For ambiguous aggregation targets (e.g. multiple numeric columns), prefer the column most semantically related to the user's query.
